The '''Explorer''' was a model of personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] designed by [[Martinique Desler]], founder of [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation/Legends|Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation]], during her [[Time/Legends|time]] at [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. It was the prototype from which all later Desler models were derived.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
